# fortiappseccloud_waf_mitb_protection

Configures MITB protection for one FortiAppSec Cloud application using the static app endpoint `/waf/apps/{ep_id}/mitb_protection`. Set `template = false` and provide `configs` to manage settings directly. Set `template = true` and omit `configs` to inherit this module from the application's attached WAF template.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_mitb_protection` resource for an application endpoint. Template-level settings are managed by `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_mitb_protection`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_mitb_protection" "example" {
  ep_id    = fortiappseccloud_waf_app.example.ep_id
  template = false

  configs {
    status      = true
    action      = "alert_deny"
    request_url = "/login"
    post_url    = "/submit"

    param_list {
      item {
        type            = "regular-input"
        name            = "password"
        obfuscate       = true
        encrypt         = false
        anti_key_logger = false
      }
    }

    domain_list {
      item {
        domain = "https://maps.googleapis.com"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `ep_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — Application endpoint ID. Import uses this exact value and it must contain a non-whitespace character.
- `template` (Required) — Whether effective configuration is inherited from the attached template.
- `configs` (Block) — Required when `template = false` and forbidden when `template = true`. State keeps this block null when template inheritance is enabled.
  - `action` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Action. One of `alert`, `alert_deny`. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `post_url` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Post url. Must match `^/.*$`. At most 255 UTF-8 characters. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `request_url` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Request url. Must match `^/.*$`. At most 255 UTF-8 characters. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `status` (Optional, Computed) — Enables or disables MITB protection. Omission preserves the current value.
  - Collection ownership — Each block below contains ordered `item` blocks. Omitting a collection block preserves the complete raw remote array and keeps the block null in state. A present empty block sends `[]`. A present block with items replaces the complete array in Terraform order.
    - `domain_list` (Optional Block, at most 256 items) — Owns the ordered `domain_list.item` blocks.
      - `domain_list.item.domain` (Required, maximum 255 UTF-8 characters) — Domain.
    - `param_list` (Optional Block, at most 256 items) — Owns the ordered `param_list.item` blocks.
      - `param_list.item.anti_key_logger` (Optional, Computed) — Anti key logger. Defaults to `false` for a newly configured item.
      - `param_list.item.encrypt` (Optional, Computed) — Encrypt. Defaults to `false` for a newly configured item.
      - `param_list.item.name` (Required, maximum 63 UTF-8 characters) — Rule name.
      - `param_list.item.obfuscate` (Optional, Computed) — Obfuscate. Defaults to `false` for a newly configured item.
      - `param_list.item.type` (Required, one of `password-input`, `regular-input`) — Type.

The wire-only `idx` field is never exposed. The provider regenerates sequential one-based indices independently for each list, validates imported or owned response indices, and sorts state by `idx`. Unknown nested item keys fail closed for owned and imported arrays; omitted top-level collection wrappers remain opaque and are preserved unchanged.


## Import

Import using the application `ep_id`:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_mitb_protection.example application-endpoint-id
```

The first read after import hydrates all ownership wrappers when `template = false`.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
